Three Concepts

Coast, Lowcountry and Latin on one table

Three distinct culinary styles from one catering team. Mix and match them on a single menu so every guest finds a favorite.

Fresh From the Coast

Coastal Seafood

Mussels in white wine, garlic shrimp, ceviche and seafood paella built around fresh coastal catch.

Rooted in the South

Lowcountry Tradition

Our Lowcountry boil piles shell-on shrimp, corn, house-seasoned potatoes and sausage high for the whole table.

Big, Bold and Bright

Latin Flavor

Taco and fajita bars, empanadas, tostones, ropa vieja and Cuban pork that turn any event into a fiesta.

Our Mission
To bring people together through memorable food and genuine hospitality, blending coastal seafood, Lowcountry tradition, and bold Latin flavor into seamless, beautifully executed events.
